faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for BNU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 24 November 2026, and candidates report at 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in BNU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: 2 Junior Teacher (MBA), 1 Senior Teacher (MCA), 1 Junior Teacher (MCA), 1 Full-time Teacher (Political Science), 1 Part-time Teacher (Political Science), 1 Part-time Guest Lecturer (Constitutional Moral Values - Political Science) and 1 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for BNU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 24 November 2026 at 10:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Honorarium as per University rules for Junior Teacher (MBA), Honorarium as per University rules for Senior Teacher (MCA), Honorarium as per University rules for Junior Teacher (MCA), Honorarium as per University rules for Full-time Teacher (Political Science), Honorarium as per University rules for Part-time Teacher (Political Science).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post Graduate degree in the relevant subject with Ph.D./NET/SLET; the notice addresses candidates with teaching experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. NOC from the head of the institution previously worked in must be submitted to the University.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Selection by walk-in interview; the University's decision on selection is final. Appointments follow the workload of each subject and the Government reservation.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Posts are entirely temporary. Service is taken until the end of the respective academic year. Appointment order is issued after obtaining a suitable undertaking.

faq.question: Q9. Which places are covered by BNU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Post Graduate Centre, Mangasandra, Kolar (MBA, MCA, Chemistry, Political Science PG courses), University constituent college, Lingarajapuram, Bengaluru (Constitutional Moral Values, UG degree).

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Fully filled application form; Original marks cards; Degree certificate; Service experience certificate; Ph.D./NET/SLET and research papers, and other necessary documents; 2 sets of photocopies of the documents.
